text:
On these facts, the admitted indifference to the consequences of reckless driving is recklessness, so the best conclusion is reckless infliction of serious bodily injury, not an intent-based offense. That conflicts with the team note, and neither listed option fits cleanly: he denied intending injury, which defeats assault with intent to cause serious bodily injury, and attempted manslaughter requires intent to kill. If I must pick one of the two, I'd choose assault, read as aggravated assault based on recklessly causing serious injury, but the team should check the jurisdiction's definitions before relying on it.

CONFIDENCE: 35
